# /crav1-specs-to-ado

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From specs to Azure Boards](../../from-specs-to-ado.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-specs-to-ado/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Turn picked feature candidates into Azure Boards Features.

Sends picked candidates to Azure Boards as Features after a yes, then writes the id onto the spec.

## Runs when

Send picked candidates to Azure Boards. Called by the user.

## Reads

In short: The org, the project, and the candidate list.

Reads the org and project from `docs/environments/marks.md` or Azure DevOps URLs in `docs/system/repos.md`, checks `az` including the default install paths, checks that the project has the Feature work item type, reads the Feature fields before the preview, and reads the candidate list. When the type has Acceptance Criteria, the checks go there. When it does not, the checks go in the Description as an Acceptance checks list and that field is not sent.

## Writes

In short: A Feature in Azure Boards after a yes, then its id in that spec's `work-item.md` or a landscape "No spec yet in ADO" row.

Writes a Feature only after the user says yes. After a Create, writing the new id into that spec’s `work-item.md` with its milestone or slice label, or a row on the landscape “No spec yet in ADO” table when the item has no spec, is required.

## Does not

Leaves the preview unedited, Iteration and Priority blank, and the specs repo out of anything sent.

Limits and exceptions: a missing Feature type stops. An `az` failure, including a failed field read, states the issue, suggests a fix such as `az login`, and offers a skip. It does not guess. It does not show the `az` command. It does not install or log in. The closing output names the file written, says it is not committed yet, names [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md), and says a later run would offer Create again. If the write fails, it prints the line to add. It does not start Specify, Plan, or Build. It is not a starter option.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls [`/crav1-feature-candidates`](crav1-feature-candidates.md), and [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md) when a preview change belongs in the spec.

## Lane and group

Lane: Cross-cutting. Group: Azure Boards. Starter option: no. Routing: [guild routing](../../guild-routing.md).

Stage: stable. Since: 1.31.0 ([changelog](../../../CHANGELOG.md)).
